candidates.change_summary: Replace the line that sets newOracle to create EmergencyOracle with one that passes address(this) as owner instead of msg.sender, so the created oracle's owner differs and the emitted newOracle address (the contract instance) remains same but its owner is different; the observable newEmergencyOracle() return (the emitted address) is unchanged but the created oracle's owner is different — however since the target observable is the state variable newEmergencyOracle (the event/new oracle address) this mutant changes behavior because the creator/owner differs (external observers may interact differently).
Replace the emit so that the event reports the contract (address(this)) as the owner instead of msg.sender, changing the externally visible owner field in the event emitted after creating the oracle.

Modify the onlyJojoTeam modifier to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so calls forwarded through other contracts may now be allowed or rejected, changing whether newEmergencyOracle can be called and thus the resulting newOracle state.
Invert the require condition so that only non-jojoTeam callers can call, altering whether newEmergencyOracle can be invoked and thus changing whether newEmergencyOracle state/event is produced.
